advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Consider tightening the 404/409 idempotent markers to match an HTTP status token (e.g. word-boundary or a status-line prefix) rather than a bare substring anywhere in stderr.
evidence: src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/dispatch_one.py:683: text = stderr.lower(); return any(marker in text for marker in _IDEMPOTENT_LINK_REMOVAL_MARKERS)

This preserves the pre-existing 404/409 idempotent contract (delete_issue_link docstring, acli_graph.py:643-645), so it is not a regression — but the substring match is looser than a status-code/HTTP-line match and can spuriously re-inflate applied, the exact class of bug 5528 addresses.
advisory.finding: The idempotent-removal markers '404' and '409' are matched as bare case-insensitive substrings anywhere in ACLI stderr, so a delete failure whose stderr merely contains those digits for an unrelated reason (an embedded numeric id, a byte count, an unrelated diagnostic) would be misclassified as a proven-gone link and counted applied rather than failed.
